summary: Live preview verification of iteration 22 (IconFontGate + isolated store-review access + website D2/D3/D4). Backend: 22/22 live-preview endpoint tests pass against EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Frontend: mobile viewport 390x844 boots through IconFontGate, no icon-font-error surfaces, diamond Ionicon renders, 'Store reviewer access' link navigates to /review-access with all 6 required testIDs and initially-disabled login button; wrong key surfaces review-login-error via 401 REVIEW_CREDENTIALS_INVALID; store-review-customer login lands on tabs/home with (sample) products and the gold STORE-REVIEW ENVIRONMENT banner; store-review-admin lands on /panel with ADMIN role and synthetic dashboard. Health returns 503 (overall not_ready) with flows.review.ready=true and flows.staff.ready=false [STAFF_SERVICE_KEY] as expected per preview contract. Access keys were never printed. No .env or supervisor changes were made. No React Native / Expo deprecated packages surfaced in the touched files.

minor.issue: For a canonical-format but unknown UID (e.g. 'review-customer-9999' or 'does-not-exist') the endpoint uses identity() which falls back to phone parsing and returns 422 INVALID_PHONE instead of 404 USER_NOT_FOUND/CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND. /api/requests?customer_id=... does return 404 CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND correctly, so D3's staff-side listing behaves as spec'd; only the direct customer-detail lookup is inconsistent.

Cloudflare strips upstream 'content-length: 389724' on /api/fonts/ionicons.ttf (both GET and HEAD) because it re-encodes with Transfer-Encoding: chunked / Content-Encoding: gzip. Origin (uvicorn on :8001) still returns content-length: 389724. Body length + x-font-sha256 still match the manifest, so integrity is verifiable; but any strict client relying on Content-Length via the CDN will not see it.

react_native_issues.issue: Console emits 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow) and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated (use style.pointerEvents)'. These are informational deprecation warnings from react-native-web on the preview; UI still renders correctly. Recommend migrating to boxShadow / style.pointerEvents to future-proof.

action_items: Make GET /api/customers/{uid} return 404 CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND (or reuse customer_scope) for canonical-format IDs that don't exist, instead of leaking a phone-parse 422 through identity(). Suggested fix: in people.py customer_detail(), skip the by_phone fallback (or gate it on ref matching a phone shape) when the ref matches CUSTOMER_ID regex from queries.py and the id lookup misses.
Optional: audit react-native-web deprecations (shadow*/pointerEvents) surfaced on the preview and migrate to boxShadow / style.pointerEvents to silence dev-warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: people.identity() couples id-lookup with phone-lookup fallback. When used from /customers/{uid} this changes the error semantics from 404 to 422 INVALID_PHONE on unknown canonical IDs. Consider separating 'lookup-by-canonical-id' (used by /customers/{uid}) from 'lookup-by-any-ref' (used by staff-create/patch flows).

Preview /api/health returns HTTP 503 because overall status=not_ready (staff placeholder). This is by design per review_request, but any external monitor should hit /api/health/live (200) for uptime and reserve /api/health for readiness.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (IconFontGate boot, login → /review-access → wrong-key 401 → customer session banner+sample → admin /panel banner+ADMIN)

No icon-font-error appears. Screenshots at /app/test_reports/iteration22_*.jpeg.
rca_of_issue: The /api/customers/{uid} discrepancy stems from shared/people.py::identity() which does an id-lookup then falls back to c.by_phone(c.phone(ref)); c.phone() raises 422 INVALID_PHONE when the ref is not 10-digit. For canonical customer IDs (regex ^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,64}$) the fallback is inappropriate and masks the desired 404. Fix: in customer_detail() (line ~207-213), lookup users.find_one({'id': uid}) directly and fail(404, 'CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND', ...) when missing, matching the semantics used by queries.py::customer_scope().
